properties.name: WHAT WORKED, re-measured on 0.77.0 (2026-10-02): `--call find_tools` returns ranked tools with parameter names and a one-sentence summary, and says how many it matched, omitted and searched, in ~0.13–0.22 s. It is a --call agent's only catalogue. Do not regress it. Its items carry no read-only/write marker, which is one reason limitation 2 has no served answer
properties.statement:
From the "Measured" table of art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02 ("--call find_tools: ranked tools with parameter names and summaries"), re-measured by triage agent D (0.77.0, scratch store; log /home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/triage-D/measure.log).

HOLDS. `--call find_tools --args '{"query":"import a whole design document from a file","limit":3}'` → exit 0, 0.22 s. It ranked import_graph first (parameters accept_newer, document, path; summary "Load an exported design into this graph."), then documents and ingest_corpus_step, with matched 193, omitted 190, searched 193. Each item has exactly four keys: tool, summary, parameters, score.

WHAT IT DOES NOT CARRY, measured, for the door's readers:
- no read-only/write marker. A --call agent therefore cannot learn the read set (78 of 195 tools on main) from anything served, which bears on limitation 2 (fact:root-cause-one-regex-cannot-separate-door-reads-because-the-read-set-is-not-in-the-command-and-not-served-2026-10-02);
- no types or required-ness (limitation 5, another agent's slice).

Two side observations, one line each:
- the served surface searched is 193 tools, while main's toolsnaps hold 195 files. dimension_drifts, manual_work_report and record_change have snaps but were not among the 192 a broad query returned. Whether that is deliberate (stub, alias) is NOT ESTABLISHED here;
- the reporter's friction row "find_tools for 'read one node by id with its properties and edges' does not return get_node" reproduces (top 5: create_edges, draw_edges, scan_nodes, add_actor, describe_schema). That row belongs to another triage slice.
